title: MessagesFile
description: `messages.yaml`, in the order the app lists them.

id.description:
Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, e.g. `engine-fire-l`, so a step, a link or a
pack extending this one can name it.

level.description: How serious it is, which sets its badge, its colors and the level filter it is under.

list.description: The list that deals with it.

no_list.description: Without a list: why none is needed, e.g. a memo that only reminds.

steps.description: The steps that deal with it, in order: each shows the message that calls for it.

text.description: The message as the alert display shows it, e.g. `ENGINE FIRE L`.

MessageLevel.description:
How serious a message is. The app draws each level in its own theme colors and always
writes its name; a pack never sets a color.

oneOf.description: A warning, the most serious level; its filter comes first.
A caution; its filter comes after warnings.
An advisory; its filter comes after cautions.
A memo; its filter comes after advisories.
A status message; its filter comes last.

StepId.description:
A stable step id: `<pack-id>.<phase>.<short-name>`, e.g. `demo-aircraft.preflight.irs-mode`.
An id never changes once published, even if the step is reworded or moved to another phase.
